thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: PROD /v1/generate 503 spike — severity: P1 — alerted at 2025-11-04T21:35:00Z

sahil: seeing this on the alert. 503s from runtime frontends and a bunch of timeouts. paging oncall. anyone oncall?

maria: I'm here. pulling dashboards now — route /v1/generate 5xx rate jumped from 0.3% -> 18% in 6m. latency p95 up from 120ms -> 1.6s.

amelia: logs show a flood of long-context streaming requests. KV cache miss rate also spiked. many workers reporting "max_inflight reached" in runtime logs.

sahil: ok likely backpressure + queue overflow. we should do live mitigations: 1) soft rate cap for anonymous/free tokens 2) tighten max_inflight on runtime nodes 3) disable streaming fallback for heavy routes 4) temporary quota bump for a few paid customers if impacted.

maria: agree. propose steps: a) add edge rate-limit for /v1/generate: 40rps global, 10rps anonymous b) change runtime max_inflight from 220 -> 120 c) lowering runtime request timeout from 30s -> 18s (to free stuck workers) d) enable shedding for heavy payloads (>2M tokens?).

kevin: +1. which is least risky to flip first?

amelia: edge rate-limit is safest and reversible. I'll push a policy to traffic-shaper.

amalia: (typo) putting command here:
```
# traffic-shaper CLI
traffic-shaper apply --route "/v1/generate" --policy '{"global_rps":40,"anonymous_rps":10,"burst":8}'
```

maria: also preparing runtime change. runtime-config patch:
```
{"runtime_max_inflight":120, "request_timeout_sec":18, "enable_streaming_fallback":false}
```

amelia: deploying traffic-shaper now

amelia: deploy-bot: started traffic-shaper rollout (policy-id: ts-2025-11-04-01)

amelia: applied, edges showing new token buckets. early telemetry: ingress rps dropped ~17% on /v1/generate within 30s.

sahil: nice — do we still see 5xxs?

amelia: 5xx rate falling to 6% now. still high for a few customers.

cs-sally: CS update: BetaCorp and SunriseApp reported errors. BetaCorp error rate 9%, Sunrise 7%. I've DM'd both and offered to open priority support.

maria: rolling runtime config to a subset of nodes (canary first):
```
# k8s patch
kubectl -n runtime set env deploy/runtime-worker --all --env="MAX_INFLIGHT=120" --env="REQUEST_TIMEOUT=18"
```

maria: canary applied to 10% of workers. monitoring.

amelia: we should also proactively disable the heavy-feature flag for streaming long-context to reduce KV cache pressure: ffctl set prod disable_streaming_long_context=true --reason="mitigation"

amelia: flipped ff. payload size distribution shows fewer giant requests.

kevin: metrics: p95 dropped to 480ms, 5xx down to 2.8% cluster-wide, but two paid customers still seeing 5-6% errors.

sahil: for those customers we should do temporary quota bump and route them to dedicated lower-latency pool. maria can you coordinate?

maria: on it. identifying accounts: BetaCorp (acct-3772), ScaleLabs (acct-981). proposing immediate quota bump x2 for 30m and route via dedicated-pool-a. exec commands:
```
# admin
redwood-admin quota set acct-3772 --limit-reqs-per-min 1200 --ttl 1800
redwood-admin route set acct-3772 --pool dedicated-pool-a
```

maria: applied for acct-3772 and acct-981. CS notified.

deploy-bot: Can confirm runtime canary succeeded on 10% nodes. No crashes.

amelia: canary -> 50% -> full rollout in 6m if stable.

sahil: also enabling shedding policy on runtime: reject requests when queue depth > 800 with 429 (prefer 429 over 503). nova config snippet:
```
{ "shedding": {"queue_threshold":800, "response_code":429, "log_sample_rate":0.1 }}
```

maria: added shedding. logs show 429 being returned mainly to anonymous tokens and excessive streaming attempts. 5xx rate now <1.2%.

cs-sally: CS: BetaCorp errors dropped to 0.8% after routing to dedicated pool and quota bump. SunriseApp confirmed degraded UX but stable.

kevin: ping on postmortem: what's the root cause?

amelia: initial cause = sudden influx of very long streaming requests (third-party integration gone wild) + a regression in KV cache eviction that increased miss ratio. combo caused runtime nodes to hit max_inflight and block new requests, producing upstream 503s.

sahil: mitigation summary for handoff: 1) Edge rate-limit for /v1/generate active 40rps global / 10rps anon 2) Runtime max_inflight lowered to 120 (rolled back to previous config after stable) 3) Request timeout reduced to 18s 4) Streaming long-context FF disabled 5) Shedding enabled with 429 6) Temporary quota bumps and routing for affected paid customers.

sahil: current status: system stable, 5xx < 1%, p95 ~220ms. continuing to monitor 30m. Kevin, you'll own overnight watch and follow up on postmortem.

kevin: got it. I'll keep an eye and run the postmortem draft in the morning. Notes: capture timeline, mitigation TTLs, and action item to add automated detection for rising KV miss rate + auto-shed.

sahil: thanks all. handoff checklist in thread: 
- confirm FF remains disabled until postmortem
- schedule KV eviction rollback investigation with ML infra
- add alert for sustained max_inflight > 150 across N nodes
- update runbook for quota bump + dedicated routing

amelia: I'll leave the edge policy and shedding in place for now; will document.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated — status changed to MONITORING by sahil at 2025-11-04T21:41:40Z

kevin: taking over. I'll post updates if anything changes. :raised_hands:
